Organic mobile MAU — changepoint probes, round3

Changepoint range {0.84, 0.87, 0.9} × changepoint prior scale {0.004, 0.005, 0.0065, 0.008} on the organic series with the India + Indonesia iOS-rate cap; October 2026 mobile lock otherwise, Iran 2026 bridged in training. Last organic actual the probes trained on, 2026-10-09: 46,986,901 (+6.9% YoY). Targets (the round-2 brief): seam step within ±1%, Dec→Dec slope in the +3%..+8% band. Meets both: none.

Reading of round 3 (stop here for Brendan's call)

Brendan, after round 2: "0.005/0.87 is the best so far ... walk around that space in both axes to see if we can do marginally better." The 3 × 4 neighbourhood (range 0.84 / 0.87 / 0.90 × prior 0.004 / 0.005 / 0.0065 / 0.008; the centre reused from round 2) is a smooth frontier: every step toward a closed seam is a step up in 2027 slope, with no setting that improves one without costing the other.
  • Marginally better than the centre, yes. Prior 0.0065 at range 0.87: seam −1.5% (centre −2.1%), Dec→Dec +7.3% (centre +6.1%), 2027-12-15 51.5M. Still inside the slope band, with the seam 0.6 pt closer; the Oct-9→Oct-9 2027 growth is +6.0%, below the capped data's own +6.9% last year.
  • Seam met at the band's edge. Prior 0.008 at range 0.87: seam −0.8%, Dec→Dec +8.9%, 52.9M. Also prior 0.0065 at range 0.90: −0.6% / +10.5%. Both close the seam by letting the last trend segment take more of the high spend period.
  • The two axes move the same thing. Range 0.84 (last changepoint ≈ 2025-10-02) opens −2.4% to −3.3% at +3.9% to +5.5% whatever the prior; range 0.90 (≈ 2026-03-13) runs from −2.3% / +6.1% at prior 0.004 to +0.4% / +14.2% at 0.008. Prior and range are nearly interchangeable along the frontier (see the scatter below), so there is no second dimension to exploit.
  • What the frontier says. Roughly 2 points of 2027 slope per point of seam closed. From the centre to a closed seam is about +4 pt of Dec→Dec growth, i.e. from "2027 grows like 2023–2025 plus a little" to "2027 grows like the high spend period minus a little".
  • Recommendation. Prior 0.0065 / range 0.87 if the brief's band is the rule; prior 0.008 / range 0.87 if the seam matters more and +9% is acceptable. Either way the pick is a position on the attribution question, and the uncorrected round-1 runs remain the rollback comparison.

1. The data correction in force: iOS-rate cap, ID + IN from 2026-04-01

Provisional (Brendan 2026-10-15; may be rolled back on the marketing DS team's read — rollback is dropping --ios-rate-cap, see data-official/2027-glean-draft/organic_mau/ios_rate_cap/IOS_RATE_CAP.md). Organic Fenix MAU training rows in these countries are capped at the level they would reach by growing at the country's own Firefox iOS rate (trailing 28-day mean ratio); the positive excess is treated as paid and removed, nothing is added back. Evidence: data-official/2027-glean-draft/organic_mau/paid_organic_correlation.html (section D).
